notes.title: Stage Five Update
notes.content:
The new update is finally here! In our last post we told you about our successful test run at the Dokomi Japan-Expo, and now we release the update for everyone on Steam to enjoy. Here are all the fancy new additions we have in store for you.

[h1]Factory Stage[/h1]

The game gets a major content upgrade with the addition of the Factory as the fifth stage. It features conveyor belts, that disturb your movement, robotic enemies with shock attacks and other dangers.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44869002/518071179e5dae5d3c6bca582c8339e001834071.gif[/img]

[h1]Reaper Boss[/h1]

Leading the army of undead foes in the Town stage is no one else, than the mighty grim reaper – death himself. He is a powerful trickster with a variety of strange abilities. Can you evade his frantic attacks, or will he collect your soul?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44869002/95ba16b75364a53ca4944bad1891757ddaff72ab.gif[/img]

[h3]Additions[/h3]
[list]
[*] New fifth stage: the factory
[*] New town boss with soundtrack
[*] Input mapping screen and new mouse mode
[*] Stage result bonus screen with coins and stars
[*] New special attack for Walter
[*] Conjure venom skill replacing King of the Night for Walter
[*] Special notes for temple boss
[*] Effect resistance for amulets
[*] Visual effect for low energy level
[*] Stage number and level for region title splash
[*] Added more information to the status screen
[*] Added display for status effects
[/list]

[h3]New Enemies[/h3]
[list]
[*] Eye Walker
[*] Blinky
[*] Mini Bit
[*] Hover Disc
[*] Cube
[*] Screamy
[*] Blight Burster
[/list]

[h3]Adjustments[/h3]
[list]
[*] Less mask spawns in temple
[*] Moved drone to factory
[*] Moved brain crawler to factory
[*] Owl boss spawns less gnomes
[*] Adjust damage/health difficulty curve for five stages
[*] Adjust status effect graphic effect strength
[*] Enemies move faster when on fire
[*] Temple boss has more health points
[*] Scorchling has less health
[*] Lower chance for Scorchling Rush
[*] Health upgrades are cheaper but weaker
[*] Critical chance upgrades are more expensive and weaker
[*] Status effects do not affect projectile speeds
[*] Shocking experience des not affect bullets
[*] Explosions do not pass effects to invincible entities
[*] Weakened Mirror Shot
[*] Weakened Target Locked
[*] Snare damage upgrade has less effect
[*] More enemies in the mansion
[*] The mansion boss has more health points
[*] Astral enemy has more health points
[*] Companion mimics expire faster
[*] Flying masks are weaker
[/list]

[h3]Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Entities on level borders receive damage properly
[*] Intimidate skill now does not self-terrify the player
[*] Boss entities can not be cursed
[/list]

notes.title: New Stage, Boss, & More!
notes.content:
Yes, you read that right! We have been busy creating new content and are currently finishing up a big update. We want to tell you about all the good stuff that will be added to the game soon.

[h1]Factory Stage[/h1]

The fifth stage has been assembled and we are proud to present the new factory! This stage offers a fast paced experience, that requires precise movement to maneuver on the moving conveyor belts. You’ll encounter many robotic enemies, electrifying defenses and some strange mutations.

[url=https://beatsofbetrayal.com/new-stage-boss-more/][img]https://beatsofbetrayal.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/01/factory8-1.gif[/img][/url]

The boss fight against the tank will be moved from the town stage to the factory stage, which fits the theme perfectly with the factory assembling the tank as you progress through the stage. The town stage will get a new boss fight instead.

[h1]Reaper Boss Fight[/h1]

With the tank being moved to the factory, the town was in dire need for a new boss fight. The undead foes lurking in this stage will have a new leader: The Reaper! Are you ready for a showdown on the graveyard?

[url=https://beatsofbetrayal.com/new-stage-boss-more/][img]https://beatsofbetrayal.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/01/graveyard-1.gif[/img][/url]

[h1]New Shops[/h1]

Even though most people assume otherwise, undead creatures want options when it comes to grocery shopping, just like the living. The B-Mart finally has some healthy competition. A-Mart and Z-Mart will open their shops for you, adding visual variety with their bright signature colors.

[url=https://beatsofbetrayal.com/new-stage-boss-more/][img]https://beatsofbetrayal.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/01/mart.png[/img][/url]

[h1]Input Bindings[/h1]

Over the course of developing this game, we tested multiple control schemes and button layouts. We are happy with the current default, but there are a lot of reasons why people might need to customize input bindings. With the upcoming update, this will finally be possible.

[url=https://beatsofbetrayal.com/new-stage-boss-more/][img]https://beatsofbetrayal.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/01/screamy-1.gif[/img][/url]

[h1]Walter Special Attack[/h1]

We felt that Walter’s special attack was slightly underwhelming compared to the others. That’s why it will be replaced with a new one. Walter will now spray red cherry juice all over his enemies – just as vampires typically do. The sheer pressure of the spray causes recoil, adding an extra layer of chaos to the fight.

[url=https://beatsofbetrayal.com/new-stage-boss-more/][img]https://beatsofbetrayal.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/01/special.gif[/img][/url]

[h1]Soon™[/h1]

We are still working on the Reaper boss fight and we can not yet name a date. However, we have most of the update complete, so stay tuned! See more about the update [url=https://beatsofbetrayal.com/new-stage-boss-more/]here[/url].

[url=https://beatsofbetrayal.com/new-stage-boss-more/][img]https://beatsofbetrayal.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/01/reaper-1.gif[/img][/url]
